# Peptide Scientific

> B2B supplier of research-grade peptides, custom peptide synthesis and independent HPLC / LC-MS analytical services for institutional laboratories, CROs and analytical facilities. For in-vitro laboratory research use only. Not for human or veterinary use, and not for diagnostic or therapeutic use. Institutional supply only.

Peptide Scientific is a business-to-business research supplier. Every lot is released against independent analytical data and ships with a batch-specific Certificate of Analysis (COA), Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and chain-of-custody record. Pricing and lead time are quoted per project; the website is an inquiry channel, not a consumer checkout.

## Compliance

- Supplied for in-vitro laboratory research use only.
- Not for human or veterinary use. Not for diagnostic or therapeutic use.
- Sold to qualified research institutions only; not to consumers.

## Reference catalogue

- BPC-157 Reference Standard — CAS 137525-51-0, MW 1419.5 Da, purity ≥98% (HPLC). For in-vitro research use only.
- TB-500 Reference Standard — CAS 77591-33-4, MW 889.0 Da, purity ≥98% (HPLC). Thymosin beta-4 fragment (17–23).
- MOTS-c Reference Standard — CAS 1963811-16-3, MW 2170.6 Da, purity ≥97% (HPLC).
- GLP-1 (7-36) Amide Reference Standard — CAS 107444-51-9, MW 3297.7 Da, purity ≥95% (HPLC).

## Capabilities

- Custom peptide synthesis: sequence-to-vial synthesis, HPLC purification, independent MS confirmation, gram scale.
- Analytical services: RP-HPLC purity, ESI-LC-MS identity, water content and appearance testing, signed report.
- Documentation: batch-specific COA, SDS / MSDS, Certificate of Origin, export documentation, cold-chain packing record.
- Batch traceability: lot code linked to release record and chain of custody.
